BiblicalUsage: Elisheba is the wife of Aaron. In Exodus 6:23, the text says "And Aaron took him Elisheba." The life behind the name is told on the Elisheba People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elisheba matters because God knows His people by name, and Elisheba is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
